mechanism_narrative: The level of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 20-day returns: higher unemployment rates indicate weaker economic conditions, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 210.5 signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
